form.lockedWarningTitle: Registration Locked: No scheduled lessons in the timetable for the selected date/session!
form.lockedWarningDesc: Leave requests must fall on dates and sessions with scheduled lessons in Class {{className}}'s timetable. Please switch to Full Day / Active Session or choose another study date.
form.autoNotificationNotice: Upon submission, the system automatically sends notifications and Emails to your Homeroom Teacher ({{teacherName}}) and the Subject Teachers of the selected lessons below (if the Homeroom Teacher is also a Subject Teacher, only 1 consolidated notification is sent). The Homeroom Teacher approval deadline is 3 hours before the first lesson starts; after this deadline, the system automatically approves the request and notifies both the student and Subject Teachers.
form.noLessonsInSlot: This session or date has no scheduled lessons in the timetable (Lesson selection locked).
form.deadlineLabel: Homeroom Teacher Approval Deadline (3 hours prior):
form.deadlineAutoApproveHint: If not reviewed before the deadline above, the system will automatically approve and send result Emails.
form.homeroomCombinedDesc: Homeroom Teacher & Subject Teacher for {{subjects}} ({{count}} periods) • Consolidated single delivery
form.policyRule1: Leave dates must fall on study days and sessions that have scheduled lessons in the timetable.
form.policyRule2: Upon submission, notifications and Emails are sent to the Homeroom Teacher and Subject Teachers (consolidated into 1 delivery if the Homeroom Teacher also teaches the subject).
form.policyRule3: The Homeroom Teacher's approval window runs from submission until 3 hours before the first lesson starts. Overdue requests are automatically approved.
form.policyRule4: Once approved (by the Homeroom Teacher or automatically), the system sends a confirmation Email to the Student and notifies Subject Teachers.
